== Course of events ==

Following the Dodo's pronouncement that all are winners and must receive their prizes, Alice and the Mouse gather upon the bank. The Mouse then proposes an unexpected remedy: the recitation of history, a dry subject that might serve to dry them.

This curious proposal represents a moment of improvisation and companionship between Alice and the Mouse. What follows is the distribution of prizes, as Alice begins to dispense comfits from her pocket as rewards.
